notes: Uses sum-of-squares freestream deficit superposition (sosfs), the TurbineGrid, 3 x 3 square rotor grid with power cubic-mean, thrust cubic-mean averaging, and Crespo-Hernandez wake-added turbulence. Uses Betz induction, quadratic wind-speed superposition with a local (ws_quadratic) deficit reference, grid16, 4 x 4 cell centers rotor sampling, rotor-point partial wakes, and the rotor_wd wake frame. No separate wake-added turbulence model is configured.
